title: Derived source comparison detects classes
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories with enough injectives and bounded-below derived categories, and let V:C→D be exact and additive. Fix L in C, B in D, and a:B→V(L). Assume that for every injective I, g↦a≫V(g) is a bijection Hom_C(L,I)→Hom_D(B,V(I)), and V(I) is right-acyclic for additive Hom_D(B,-). Then for every Y and q≥0 the canonical map Hom_{D⁺(C)}(L[0],Y[0][q])→Hom_{D⁺(D)}(B[0],D⁺(V)(Y[0][q])) obtained by applying D+(V) and precomposing with a[0] followed by the inverse single comparison is injective.

source.place: Tag 03FD, first and second proof paragraphs; Tag 015E, augmentation-compatible acyclic-resolution computation

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution of Y. Use the injective-resolution Ext/cohomology-class equivalence to compute derived Hom from L by Hom_C(L,I).

Exact V preserves the augmentation quasi-isomorphism. By the assumed Hom(B,-)-acyclicity of V(I), its Hom complex computes derived Hom from B. The acyclic-resolution comparison is the augmentation-compatible one.

The maps g↦a≫V(g) are additive bijections in each degree. Functoriality and associativity make them commute with differentials. They therefore identify cohomology, in particular injectively. The cocycle realization formula identifies this cohomology map with the displayed derived map: the single comparison identifies the source and V carries the augmentation and its inverse to the corresponding maps.

mathlib_searches.query: Exact functor derived Hom comparison is injective when source Hom comparisons are bijective on injectives and forgotten injectives are acyclic
A pulled back free abelian represented sheaf corepresents evaluation and underlying injective module sheaves are acyclic for its Hom functor
mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf.H, cohomologyPresheafFunctor, GabrielPopescu.preservesInjectiveObjects; no matching scalar comparison.
InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and its apply/symm lemmas exist in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Injective.Ext.

No duplicate raw injectivity theorem. Found the free sections adjunction, ExtRightDerivedHom, the acyclic-resolution API, representedEquiv in RawRestrictedHomotopySectionsIso, and the proved evaluation-acyclicity helper in ModuleAbelianDerivedDirectImageComparison. The common-universe generic ringed-site lemma does not directly fit coefficients in u+1.

theorem derivedSourceComparison_injective
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [EnoughInjectives C] [EnoughInjectives D]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    (V : C ⥤ D) [V.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V]
    (L : C) (B : D) (a : B ⟶ V.obj L)
    (hhom : ∀ (I : C), Injective I →
      Function.Bijective (fun f : L ⟶ I ↦ a ≫ V.map f))
    (hac : ∀ (I : C), Injective I →
      (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op B)).rightAcyclic (V.obj I))
    (Y : C) (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj L ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)⟦(q : ℤ)⟧ ↦
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor D 0).map a ≫
        (V.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).inv.app L) ≫
        V.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map x)
